scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck:server && pnpm run build:web
scripts.dev: pnpm run build && PORT=5000 pnpm exec tsx src/index.ts
scripts.start: NODE_ENV=production PORT=${PORT:-5000} pnpm exec tsx src/index.ts
scripts.typecheck:workspace: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm run typecheck:client && pnpm run typecheck:server
